HOOK
Is the American consumer finally hitting the brakes?
[ON SCREEN: Tiger to camera with US consumer graphic]

WHAT IT IS
At 08:30 ET, we get the US Retail Sales report for Oct. The consensus expects 0%, down from 0.8% last month.
[ON SCREEN: Retail Sales forecast 0% vs previous 0.8%]

WHY IT MATTERS
Consumer spending drives most of the US economy. That makes this a crucial catalyst for the US Dollar Index, EUR/USD, and the S&P 500. When shoppers pull back or keep spending, interest rate expectations can shift immediately.
[ON SCREEN: Ticker symbols: US Dollar Index, EUR/USD, S&P 500]

WHAT TO WATCH
If the number lands well above 0%, it signals resilience. That could lift the greenback and pressure EUR/USD. But if spending comes in below expectations, growth worries could weigh on equities while softening the dollar.
[ON SCREEN: Bullish vs Bearish reaction scenarios]

CLOSE
